standard_prerequisites.name: The compatibility of the pullback with colimits and its right exactness
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof at source lines 1048-1049 as a pointer to a lemma of this chapter
standard_prerequisites.use: Transports the surjection from the finite direct sum to the pullback.

core_obligations: Reduce to generators: arguing as in the proof of the corresponding statement for modules generated by sections, the proof assumes the module is generated by finitely many global sections, hence a quotient of a finite direct sum of copies of the structure sheaf (proof lines 1045-1057)

Apply the pullback: since the pullback commutes with colimits and is right exact, applying it to the displayed surjection yields a surjection onto the pulled back module from a finite direct sum of copies of the structure sheaf of the source (proof lines 1058-1066)
Conclude: such a surjection exhibits the pulled back module as of finite type (proof lines 1067-1068)
proof_roadmap: 与 lemma-pullback-locally-generated 的证明同样地化归，可设 G 由有限个整体截面生成，即有满射 ⊕_{i=1..n}O_Y → G → 0。
由 f^* 与 colim 交换且右正合（本章引理），作用后得 ⊕_{i=1..n}O_X → f^*G → 0，故 f^*G 有限型。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that the pullback of a module of finite type is again of finite type (author lemma at source lines 1036-1042, label lemma-pullback-finite-type). The proof (source lines 1044-1069) reduces to a module generated by finitely many global sections using the argument of the corresponding statement for modules generated by sections, and then transports the finite presentation along the pullback by its compatibility with colimits and right exactness (proof lines 1045-1066). The reduction and the transport of the finite surjection are the content. H2.
